description: This file implements the Authorities interface with a map-backed approach, handling authorization logic for resources and operations within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes methods to add authorities, parse claims from JWT tokens, and check if certain actions are authorized based on stored authorities.

classes.name: AuthoritiesImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Authorities interface managing access controls on resources and operations.

methods.name: addOperation
methods.description: Adds an operation authority to the resource.

methods.name: addResource
methods.description: Adds a resource with activities to authorities.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Merges authorities from another Authorities instance.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a resource and activity are authorized.

methods.name: getOperationKey
methods.description: Constructs a key for an operation authority.

methods.name: getResourceKey
methods.description: Constructs a key for a resource authority.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks authorization using a resource key and activity.
